ChatLog.title: ChatLog
ChatLog.description: A single student question and Gemini AI Socratic response summary in a problem-solving stage.

studentCode.description: Anonymous student code such as S01.

sequence.description: Sequential question number for the student.

question.description: Original question text written by the student.

aiReplySummary.description: First 100 characters of the AI reply.

aiReplyFull.description: Full AI reply text for session restoration.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the question was recorded.

Submission.title: Submission
Submission.description: Final campus problem-finding assignment submission by a student.

studentCode.description: Anonymous student code such as S01.

submittedAt.description: Server timestamp when the submission was saved.

StudentSession.title: StudentSession
StudentSession.description: Tracks the active stage of a student code across app restarts.

studentCode.description: Anonymous student code such as S01.

currentStage.description: Current stage in the 4-stage workflow or submission.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last stage update.

/chatLogs/{logId}.description: Collection of student questions and Gemini reply summaries across stages.

/submissions/{submissionId}.description: Collection of final student assignment submissions.

/studentSessions/{studentCode}.description: Collection storing each student's current workflow stage for persistence across reloads.
